independent_unit: original parent recording; methods, hands, products, steps within parent correlated
zero_upper_scope: one-sided 95% binomial upper on verified success under iid Bernoulli; within each stage/hand/method product
continuous_denominator: available paired parent/hand measurements, counted explicitly; boolean rates include every registered product
all_zero_bootstrap: A paired all-zero empirical difference is descriptive; the separate upper boundary quantifies finite observed sample size.
